reserveReview.rationale: Independently recomputed under owner ruling D01 from the complete first-party 2026-10-01T11:03:47.000Z balance sheet: every asset amount is disclosed in USD and divided by totalAssets USD 104732146.4444. WTGXX's two disclosed holdings are aggregated; seven resulting weights are rounded independently to eight decimal places with no invented residual. The disclosed row sum USD 104732146.444379011496 differs from the source total by USD 0.000020988504. Existing asset-class and liquidity mappings are preserved; AUSD and USDC identities match the exact Ethereum tokens disclosed by the source.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Official Frax frxUSD balance-sheet asset values normalized by the live frax-balance-sheet adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every disclosed balance-sheet asset is represented, including AUSD and USDC. The arithmetic refresh does not establish portfolio-wide legal custody safeguards or stressed cash-out bounds; existing mappings are not upgraded.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: wtgxx-wisdomtree is a quarantined no-supply record (permitted runtime sources report no positive circulating supply or market cap) that can never carry a live score, so this slice is scored on its own fund-share asset class rather than linked as a dependency edge.
USDB is identified by the official balance sheet but remains outside the active scoring set, so it is not promoted into the active dependency graph.
EREBOR_USD is an issuer-identified FBO bank-deposit account holding frxUSD reserve cash, not a holding of the tracked frxUSD token and therefore not a dependency edge.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer's balance sheet identifies WTGXX held in Frax Inc's BitGo Trust Account and cash in a segregated Erebor Bank FBO frxUSD Stablecoin Reserve Account. Other balances are held in on-chain redemption contracts or a Solana multisig, with underlying fund and stablecoin custody outside those contracts. Provider percentages, the BitGo legal entity and account safeguards, portfolio-wide segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, and rehypothecation restrictions are not established by these sources. The institutional-top summary is retained pending a separate review of the complete custody chain.
